**Cameroon General Certificate of Education Board - General Certificate of Education Examination. Subject: Religious Studies (code 0785), ADVANCED LEVEL, June 2024. Paper 2: The Old Testament/Jewish Bible and World Faiths. Duration: three hours.**

Instructions to candidates: Answer FOUR questions chosen from any ONE SECTION ONLY. All questions carry equal marks (25 marks each).

You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers.

Sections of the paper: 1.0 The Old Testament/Jewish Bible, Section 1.1 The Patriarchs to David (questions 1 to 6); Section 5.3 Islam (questions 7 to 12); Section 5.5 African Traditional Beliefs and Practices (questions 13 to 18).

Règle de choix : le sujet impose « Answer FOUR questions chosen from any ONE SECTION ONLY ». Cette règle (4 questions d'UNE SEULE section) n'est pas exprimable avec `parmi` (un seul groupe) ni `ou` (sous-questions) : `regles_choix` reste vide dans tous les fichiers et la consigne complète est recopiée dans `introduction_markdown`.

Aucun corrigé officiel : les corrigés sont des réponses modèles rédigées de mémoire, sans accès à une source ; les références sont limitées à des passages et faits bien établis, les autres points sont formulés prudemment. À faire relire par un spécialiste des études religieuses avant mise en avant.

questions.enonce_markdown: Examine the works of the Supreme Being in ATR. (25 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**Introduction.** In African Traditional Religion (ATR) the Supreme Being is the highest God, known under many names. His works are described in myths, proverbs, names, prayers and songs rather than in written texts. The following points are general, as peoples differ.

**1. Creation.**
- He is the creator of the heavens, the earth, human beings, animals and plants. Many myths say that he made the first humans and placed them on earth. In some stories he used the divinities as helpers.
- Many names express this: "Creator", "the Maker of all things".

**2. Sustaining the world.**
- He keeps creation going: he gives rain, sun and fertility, so that crops grow, animals multiply and people have food. This is why he is called upon in times of drought and in farming festivals.
- He is the provider and the giver of children and of life.

**3. Governing and upholding order.**
- He is the ruler and the final judge. He is held to be the source of the moral code, which is enforced by divinities and ancestors. Wrongdoing may bring misfortune that is understood as his displeasure.
- He knows the secrets of hearts.

**4. Protection, help and healing.** He is turned to as a refuge in danger, sickness and in sorrow, and is believed to hear the oppressed.

**5. Control of destiny, life and death.** In many societies destiny, the length of life and death are his decisions. Some peoples also believe he gives every person a share in his own life or spirit.

**6. Delegating power.** He gives the divinities their authority and ancestors their role, and is the final cause behind them.

**7. Remoteness and nearness.** Several myths explain why he is now far from humanity, for example because of human wrongdoing, yet he is still invoked directly in distress, and so his works continue.

**Evaluation.** The Supreme Being is above all the creator and sustainer who stands behind the moral and natural order. Although he rarely has regular temples or priests in many societies, his works occupy a basic place in beliefs. The descriptions vary among peoples, and written accounts are limited by the oral tradition.

**Conclusion.** The works of the Supreme Being in ATR are creation, sustenance, moral governance, protection, control of destiny and the giving of power to the lesser beings, which makes him the foundation of the whole religious system.
